verdict.rationale: CUDA Toolkit, cuTile Python/C++, RAPIDS (Pandas/Scikit-learn compatible APIs), and RTX Neural Shaders SDK are documented official SDKs that developers can build against on this GPU. However, evidence is limited to marketing/dev-portal snippets with no independent hands-on SDK usage validation, and community threads note gaps in library support for this chip's SM120 architecture (missing tmem/tcgen05 support in main libraries). Missing for 10: independent developer corroboration of SDK usage, API reference depth, and confirmation that major AI libraries fully support this GPU's specific architecture.
